newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda to lease electric car in U.S. in May.
newsitem.headline: Honda to lease electric car in U.S. in May.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Wednesday it will launch a battery-powered electric vehicle for leasing in the United States in May.

The car, called EV Plus, is powered by nickel-metal hydride batteries. The car has a maximum driving range of 210 km when the batteries are fully charged and a top speed of 130 km per hour, a company spokesman said.
The leasing fee in the United States will be $499 per month.
The company also plans to introduce the EV Plus in Japan this autumn, the spokesman said.
The company aims to lease a total of 300 cars by 2000 in Japan, the spokesman said.
He said it has not yet decided whether to offer the car for sale rather than lease.
